events.subtitle: Yamamoto returns to the ALFIE thread

venue.name: Jazz House ALFIE
venue.address: Hama Roppongi Building 5F, 6-2-35 Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo

events.factual_description: Jazz House ALFIE's official October 2026 schedule lists Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 with Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano, Hiroshi Kagawa on bass, and Toshio Osumi on drums. ALFIE states its normal October operating pattern as doors at 18:45, performance from 19:15 to 20:45, and closing at 23:30; the October 21 listing carries a ¥5,500 music charge. ALFIE's official site identifies the venue at 6-2-35 Roppongi, Hama Roppongi Building 5F, Minato-ku, Tokyo. Space M&A's current July-December schedule independently shows the same Yamamoto/Kagawa/Osumi trio recurring on September 29, October 30, and November 28, which supports the non-scarcity priority judgment rather than serving as a duplicate of this ALFIE date.

enrichment.note: ALFIE verifies the date, trio personnel, performance time and music charge. The venue's reservation guidance says it does not accept reservations through the website or email and directs customers to telephone the club, so no web ticket URL is invented. en.why_it_matters: This is the thread RADAR began by missing: Yamamoto's long-running trio with Hiroshi Kagawa and Toshio Osumi, back in the small Roppongi room that turned a mistaken schedule reading into the project's first unfinished question. The trio itself is not rare, which is exactly why the setting matters here; ALFIE makes this a direct continuation of the listening story rather than just another Yamamoto date.
en.trip_verdict: If October 21 lands inside a Tokyo stay, actively build the evening around ALFIE. The artist-and-room connection is strong enough to make space for, but the trio's recurring Kantō schedule is a reason not to turn this single date into a special trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Éste es el hilo que RADAR empezó dejando pendiente: el trío de Yamamoto con Hiroshi Kagawa y Toshio Osumi de vuelta en la pequeña sala de Roppongi donde una lectura equivocada del calendario terminó convirtiéndose en la primera pregunta inconclusa del proyecto. El trío no es raro, y precisamente por eso aquí importa el lugar: ALFIE vuelve esta fecha una continuación directa de la historia de escucha, no sólo otro concierto de Yamamoto.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 21 de octubre cae dentro de una estancia en Tokio, sí armaría la noche alrededor de ALFIE. La conexión entre artista y sala merece hacerle espacio, pero la agenda recurrente del trío en Kantō es una buena razón para no convertir esta única fecha en un viaje especial por sí sola.
